summary: SharkNinja filed an 8-K disclosing a one-time waiver of its insider trading policy granted to Chairman CJ Xuning Wang, who sold a portion of his holdings to an existing institutional investor in an exempt transaction on July 10, 2026. The Board deemed the waiver appropriate after review. No specific stake size, price, or premium was disclosed. No advisor or recommendation was noted. The transaction was a direct sale to a single institutional investor during a blackout period. Watch for potential insider selling patterns or governance backlash.
